desc: Terrain hazard areas on an authored map (TerrainHazards, docs/decisions/0060-terrain-hazards.md). The map lists each area's outline (content/maps/<id>.json, islands[].hazard_areas: kind, poly, and safe: circles and polygons of walkable ground cut out of a big field, its paths, fords and islets); this file says what the ground does to a hunter standing on it and which Boki walks it safely. counter: an active Boki whose type (theme) or species is listed protects its hunter (a downed Boki doesn't); ward says how that and a ward perk combine. hint: the Boki says so when one is near (near_m metres, looked for every every_s seconds, the same kind again after again_s). look: the surface shader (shaders/terrain_hazard.gdshader).

ward.doc: Protection from a hazard, whatever it comes from: the best single source applies and sources never add up or double. perk: the ward perk for that ground (Data.PERKS ward names the kind; sold in shops, and an orb next to the field can roll it, PerkOrbs). boki: the Boki that is out has a counter type or species; a carried second Boki, downed or not out, adds nothing, and a Fusion is its own Boki. A strength of 1 or more keeps the hazard off the hunter completely. traps: the biome trap kind (BiomeRun) that is the same ground as each hazard kind, so one ward perk and one counter cover both.

deep_water.name: Deep Water
deep_water.hurts: slow, weak hits, short of breath
